title: Lenders Seek to Sell Debt of Rovensa as Firm Burns Cash
summary: Lenders to Partners Group-backed Rovensa are looking to offload the debt of the Iberian agricultural products maker as the firm burns through cash.

title: Investors Buy Rogers (RCI), BCE, Telus Stocks After Canada Telecom Selloff
summary: Investors are bargain hunting in Canadian telecommunication stocks after rising government-bond yields and competition from SpaceX sparked steep declines in the group.

title: Stock Rotation Hits AI Winners on Alphabet’s Miss: Markets Wrap
summary: A selloff in several tech companies spurred a rotation into a broader category of stocks while fueling a push toward the safety of bonds.

title: Venezuelan Leader Commits to Vote as Machado Applies Pressure
summary: Venezuela will hold elections organized by an overhauled electoral regulator and witnessed by the international community, acting President Delcy Rodríguez said in a rare televised address Thursday, as pressure builds on her interim government after the return of opposition leader María Corina Machado.

title: Tech Stocks Slide as Alphabet’s Record Plunge Revives AI Fears
summary: Tech stocks were dragged lower by a record drop in Alphabet Inc. after disappointing results renewed investor concerns about the threat that artificial intelligence poses to its core business.

title: Agnico Eagle (AEM) Flags Diesel Risk to Gold Output Costs Next Year
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd. warned that rising diesel prices risk raising the cost of producing gold by as much as $80 per ounce next year, signaling mounting inflationary pressures for the mining industry.

title: Amazon’s Ailing Stock Needs Booming Cloud Growth to Revive Rally
summary: Blistering cloud growth sent Amazon.com Inc. shares soaring after its last earnings report. Now with more than half those gains gone, the firm needs to deliver a repeat performance in order to reignite its faltering stock.

title: Shanghai Exchange Halts Duty-Free Metal Delivery Against Futures
summary: The Shanghai Futures Exchange has suspended the settlement of copper and aluminum futures with deliveries from duty-free warehouses, a mechanism that has long helped Chinese traders avoid paying taxes on metal that can be sold overseas.

title: Raizen Business Split Gives Shell Some Rights Over Fuel Unit
summary: Brazilian biofuels maker Raizen SA is putting a portion of its fuel distribution business for sale while also giving shareholder Shell Plc a meaningful stake in the profitable business unit, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: America’s Farm Firms Signal More Murky Times With Soaring Costs
summary: Record diesel prices and uneven agriculture exports are heaping more uncertainty onto crop traders and farmer machinery makers that are pining for a long-awaited recovery to take hold.

title: Universal Music Subscription Revenue Growth Shows Improvement
summary: Universal Music Group NV reported an increase in subscription revenue in the third quarter, buoyed by price increases and “healthy” subscriber growth, helping the world’s largest music label bounce back after two disappointing periods.

title: Accidente ferroviario eleva la presión electoral en España
summary: El accidente ferroviario más mortífero de España en más de una década llega a un mes de las elecciones y aumenta el escrutinio sobre Pedro Sánchez, mientras la seguridad y el deterioro de la infraestructura pública ganan peso en el debate político. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lula’s Top Court Problem: Moraes Passport Order Angers Brazil’s President
summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has a big Supreme Court problem. Its name is Alexandre de Moraes.

title: Polymarket Investigates Suspicious Trades on Israel Election
summary: Polymarket is investigating a string of well-timed and profitable trades on the Israeli election this week in the latest case to raise concerns about potential insider trading on prediction markets.

title: Paschi Investors Deal Crushing Blow to CEO in Win for Intesa
summary: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA’s investors overwhelmingly rejected the main element of CEO Luigi Lovaglio’s defense against a takeover by Intesa Sanpaolo SpA, setting up the world’s oldest bank for the potential loss of its independence.

title: The Fearsome Rise of the Haunted Attraction
summary: Once low-tech staples of Halloween carnivals, haunted houses have become elaborate immersive environments that can draw crowds to forgotten parts of US cities. David Dudley reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Citadel Can Subpoena Top Marshall Wace Executives, Judge Rules
summary: Citadel won access to the communications of two of Marshall Wace’s most senior executives as part of a legal fight over the British hedge fund’s recruitment of former Citadel portfolio manager Daniel Shatz as global credit head.

title: Chipotle Sales Beat as New Chicken, Chips Bring Diners Back
summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc. sales rose faster than expected in the third quarter, as more frequent menu launches and revamped loyalty offers help sustain a recovery that had been threatened by a food-illness scare. Bloomberg's Michael Halen joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: DoorDash to Buy Rival Instacart in $17 Billion Deal
summary: DoorDash Inc. agreed to buy rival Instacart in a deal that values the company at about $17 billion. The transaction is expected to close near the end of next year, the deal is still pending. DoorDash says it will keep Instacart's brand, tech products and app. Bloomberg's Natalie Lung reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)
